{{Top|leg}}

'''Confounder units''' were devices used to hide things from appearing on scans. [[Jax Pavan]] kept a small confounder unit in the same inside pocket as his [[Jax Pavan's lightsaber|lightsaber]]. In addition to his lightsaber it also kept his [[Jax Pavan's duracris poniard|duracris poniard]] from appearing during scans, which was kept in a sheath between his shoulder blades.<ref name="CNI:JT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] also used a small confounder unit to stop [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing's]] [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Aurra Sing's lightsaber|lightsaber]]-which he had taken from her-from appearing on scans.<ref name="CNII:SOS">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> N-101 Nemesis droids were fitted with state-of-the-art confounder units calculated to muddle the senses of targets, guards surveillance equipment. <ref name="TLJ">''[[The Last Jedi (novel)|The Last Jedi]]''</ref>
